subject: Reactive input for x-axis in ggplot

messages.author: b190886f123b04fd
messages.subject: Reactive input for x-axis in ggplot
parts:
I am creating an interactive graph which will change according to the input range from slider. My slider is like this

sliderInput("dd", "Time Range", min = 1000, max = 130000, value = c(2000,10000))

my original graph without the slider input is like this:

 
df <- data.frame(xrange,d)
  
output$lineChart <- renderPlot({
   
ggplot(df,aes(x=xrange,y=d))+geom_point()+geom_line()+labs(x = "Clock Cycles", y="T(s)")

},height = 400, width = 600)

Now I have a problem with the slider input. I want to use the input from slider to change value of xrange. Since the input is a range and my requirement is that xrange should be a vector of values from the given range. Eg: If the input from slider is from 30000 to 70000 then xrange should be set as a vector of values from 30000 to 70000. I tried something like this but it doesnt work.

xrange <- reactive({ cbind(input$dd[1],input$dd[2])})
 
df <- data.frame(xrange,d)
  
output$lineChart <- renderPlot({
   
ggplot(df,aes(x=xrange,y=d))+geom_point()+geom_line()+labs(x = "Clock Cycles", y="T(s)")
  
},height = 400, width = 600)

Any suggestions are welcome. I am new to shiny and r as well.
